picks.editorial_note: A £20 million MRC-funded hub led by Cambridge pairs stem-cell-derived tissue models with AI to speed drug development — a major, well-funded bet on AI accelerating preclinical medicine.
picks.title: Cambridge to lead new £20m MRC Hub to transform development of new medicines using stem cells and AI

picks.editorial_note: Purdue's Rosen Center is a partner on over $42 million in NSF Integrated Data Systems and Services grants, building national-scale AI and data cyberinfrastructure that will underpin research well beyond one campus.
picks.title: Purdue enables AI- and data- cyberinfras...
picks.university: Purdue Rosen Center for Advanced Computing

picks.editorial_note: SRI, Mayo Clinic, and the University of Florida are building an ARPA-H-funded AI system using smart glasses and cameras to guide healthcare workers through procedures like blood draws and intubation — a concrete, federally backed clinical AI application with real patient-safety stakes.
picks.title: AI guides healthcare workers through blood draws, intubation, and more - SRI

picks.editorial_note: HKU led nearly 20 global universities, including Berkeley and Tsinghua, in building RoboDojo, a unified benchmark for embodied AI robot manipulation — the kind of shared infrastructure that could set the standard for evaluating robot reliability worldwide.
picks.title: HKU Pioneers "RoboDojo": The First Hong Kong-Led Unified Benchmark for Embodied AI, Setting New Global Standards for Robot Reliability - Press Releases - Media - HKU

picks.editorial_note: UC Riverside researchers won DOE Genesis Mission Phase I funding to apply AI to quantum computing error correction and cross-lab data sharing, part of a new federal initiative directing AI toward scientific discovery infrastructure.
picks.title: UCR researchers join DOE effort to speed scientific discovery

picks.editorial_note: A Kent State researcher's DOE Genesis Mission award will mine 50 years of water-quality records with AI to locate critical minerals like copper and cobalt — a striking example of a federal AI initiative aimed directly at supply-chain and resource policy priorities.
picks.title: Kent State Researcher Selected for US Department of Energy Genesis Mission Award to Mine Decades of River Data for Critical Minerals; Kent State Today; July 29, 2026

picks.editorial_note: Imperial College London and medical device maker Smith+Nephew launched a five-year center to translate academic computer-vision research into surgical robotics — a substantial industry-academia bridge with direct clinical commercialization potential.
picks.title: New centre from Imperial and Smith+Nephew will accelerate innovation in surgical robotics

picks.editorial_note: A URI-founded startup, FastFlowLM, whose NPU-optimization software for large language models joined semiconductor giant AMD — a rare case of academic spinout technology being absorbed directly into major chip industry infrastructure.
picks.title: URI professors’ startup team joined semiconductor giant AMD

picks.editorial_note: Imperial College London and South Korea's Seoul AI Hub signed a partnership connecting Korean AI startups with Imperial's research base, extending UK-Korea AI collaboration on an international policy-relevant footing.
picks.title: Imperial and Seoul AI Hub form partnership to develop AI research programme

picks.editorial_note: A $912,000 NSF grant will fund Case Western Reserve-led work on resilient, energy-efficient generative AI for secure hospital robots — a well-funded push toward safer AI deployment in healthcare infrastructure.
picks.title: Engineering’s Gourav Datta receives more than $900K to further resilient and energy-efficient generative AI research | CWRU Newsroom | Case Western Reserve University
